skill.name: logo-generator
skill.description: Generate AI logo concepts with Replicate, remove backgrounds, trim padding, and save a transparent PNG asset.
skill.summary: Creates Replicate-powered logos and transparent PNG assets for projects.
skill.author: AayushBaniya2006

security_audit.summary: Most static command, secret-file, and filesystem findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, JavaScript template literals, or hardcoded output handling. One confirmed issue is dynamic remote URL downloading without validation. Semantic review also found third-party data processing and disabled content moderation, with no evidence of prompt injection or credential exfiltration.

remediation.suggestion: Validate transparentUrl before fetch by requiring HTTPS and allowing only expected Replicate output hosts or data URLs.
Tell users that prompts, company names, generated images, and the Replicate API token are processed through Replicate services.
Keep content moderation enabled when possible, or document why it is disabled and add acceptable-use guidance.
Warn users that public/assets/logo.png is overwritten, or add an explicit output filename option.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party API Data Processing
semantic_findings.description: The script sends user prompts and generated image URLs to Replicate models. This is intended functionality, but users need disclosure because brand names and design prompts leave the local environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The Replicate prediction calls include the composed prompt and image URL. Static analysis only flagged fetch, so the library-mediated external API processing needed semantic review.

semantic_findings.title: Content Moderation Disabled for Background Removal
semantic_findings.description: The background removal request sets content_moderation to false, and the reference documents the same setting. This weakens safety checks for uploaded image content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setting is explicitly present in both the executable script and reference documentation. It is a content-safety concern, even if the main use case is logo generation.

content.value_statement: Creating polished logo assets often requires multiple design and cleanup steps. This skill generates a logo with Replicate, removes the background, and saves a transparent PNG.
actual_capabilities: Generates 1024 by 1024 logo concepts from a text prompt using a Replicate logo model.
Accepts an optional company or brand name and appends it to the prompt.
Runs a Replicate background removal model on the generated logo output.
Trims transparent edges and adds five pixels of transparent padding with sharp.
Saves the final PNG to public/assets/logo.png in the current project.
Checks for REPLICATE_API_TOKEN before running and reports setup errors.
limitations: Requires a Replicate API token and network access.
Overwrites public/assets/logo.png on each successful run.
Generated logos may need review for trademarks, text accuracy, and brand fit.
Requires pnpm plus the replicate and sharp packages in the target project.

use_cases.title: Create startup brand drafts
use_cases.description: Generate early logo concepts for a new product before investing in a full identity system.

use_cases.title: Prepare transparent app assets
use_cases.description: Create a transparent PNG logo that can be placed into a website or dashboard asset folder.

use_cases.title: Explore visual directions
use_cases.description: Produce quick logo variations from style prompts before refining the strongest concept manually.

prompt_templates.title: Basic logo prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a clean logo for a local bakery named Flour House. Use warm colors and a simple icon.

prompt_templates.title: Style-directed logo
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a modern technology logo for NovaLedger. Use blue and green accents, geometric shapes, and clear negative space.

prompt_templates.title: Project asset logo
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a transparent logo for the dashboard project. Save it to public/assets/logo.png and keep it readable on light backgrounds.

prompt_templates.title: Detailed brand brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a premium fintech logo for ArcMint. Use a monogram, restrained gold and charcoal colors, no mascots, and strong small-size readability.

output_examples.input: Create a minimalist logo for BrayanCodes.
output_examples.output: A transparent PNG logo is saved at public/assets/logo.png, with the background removed and padding trimmed.

output_examples.input: Generate a retro badge logo for Mountain Roast.
output: A 1024 by 1024 logo concept is generated.
The background is removed through Replicate.
The final PNG is saved for use in the project.

best_practices: Include the brand name, audience, style, and color direction in the prompt.
Review every generated logo for legal clearance, text quality, and brand fit.
Move or rename the saved PNG before running another generation.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague prompts like make a cool logo without brand context.
Do not publish generated marks before checking trademark and licensing risks.
Do not run the skill with sensitive or confidential brand information without approval.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs REPLICATE_API_TOKEN in the environment before the script can run.

faq.question: Where does the logo get saved?
faq.answer: The included script saves the processed PNG to public/assets/logo.png.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing logo?
faq.answer: No. The included workflow generates a new logo and processes that generated output.

faq.question: Can I choose a different output path?
faq.answer: The current script uses a fixed output path. Modify the script if another path is required.

faq.question: Does it send data to an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts, company names, and generated image data are processed by Replicate models.

faq.question: Does it guarantee a trademark-safe logo?
faq.answer: No. Review the final logo for legal, brand, and quality issues before use.
